name: Minnesota Zoo
tagline: African penguins first, then a Northern Trail red panda and Tropics Trail lemurs — no giraffes or lions.

practical.transit_note: South of Minneapolis; car for most visitors.
practical.best_start: Tropics trail or Northern Trail icons first.

items.label: African penguin
items.one_liner: 3M Penguins of the African Coast — waddle, then zoom.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the African penguin?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Red panda
items.one_liner: Northern Trail red panda — rusty and tree-high.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Red panda?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Ring-tailed lemur
items.one_liner: Tropics Trail ring-tailed lemur — striped tail and a long stare.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Ring-tailed lemur?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Two-toed sloth
items.one_liner: Linne's two-toed sloth — hang and look twice.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Two-toed sloth?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Shark
items.one_liner: Discovery Bay sand tiger and leopard sharks — watch the swim.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Shark?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

research_notes: [2026-08-23] Official-source Wave 2b public list pass (mnzoo.org/animals complete directory). Shark is on the official zoo animals index (Discovery Bay).

Ring-tailed lemur: striped tail up or a long sit?
Tropics Trail sloth: mid-reach or statue-still?
